verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an MCP server that lets external AI clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) connect to Moneybird, plus a CLI and an API. Nothing shows a built-in AI assistant inside the Moneybird product that users can delegate tasks to. Connecting outside AI chats is an adjacent capability and earns no credit for an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
